# Contributing

## Mod Support
Read https://github.com/Chitak985/khemistry/wiki/Khemistry-for-modders, but generally just tell me and I can add it. (or you can make a pull request to do so)

## New Features
This has to be confirmed with me and checked to make sure it is realistic.

## New Resources
If this is at least slightly realistic, I'm perfectly fine with it.

## New Parts
Like with resources, if it is at least slightly realistic, I'm fine with it.
